title: Machines (administration)
explain: You see that machines exist, who owns them and their state, never what is on them. Each action asks for the machine's name and a fresh second-factor code.
reasonShared: The reason is shown to everyone who can see the machine.
emergencyWarning: This opens a 30-minute session with the machine's administrator rights. Its owner is told at once, with your reason, and keeps the list of what you do.
